values.note: $10 a night includes one vehicle; $5 a night for each additional vehicle (interagency passes do not apply to the extra-vehicle fee).

note: USFS (Custer Gallatin NF, Gardiner RD) campground in Yankee Jim Canyon, 15 mi N of Gardiner on US-89, across the highway from the Yellowstone River. No trash pickup (pack in/pack out) and no firewood. --Claude
